svg.title: Project presentation and final submission dates
svg.desc: Upload one team PowerPoint to LMS by Sunday, December 6, 2026, 11:59 PM KST. Team presentations are Monday, December 7 and Thursday, December 10, 2026. Submit the final code repository URL and full 40-character commit ID to LMS by Friday, December 11, 2026, 11:59 PM KST.

g.text: Final code: LMS repository URL + commit ID
The final code submission requires the full 40-character commit ID.
